title: Marge NDE 14
content: I was having chest pain and was admitted to the hospital for an angiogram to rule out heart disease.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes During the procedure, some of the dye got into the heart muscles causing the heart to stop beating.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I was surrounded by an extremely soft, wonderful grayness, accompanied with a wonderful sense of absolute peace and happiness.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was surrendering myself to the wonderful peace I was feeling, listening to the doctor and nurses, when they started calling 'Lydia, come back" repeatedly. Then I heard the nurse say "I don't think that's her name'. When the doctor asked what my name was, I became very angry because he was treating me and didn't even know my name. So I ripped myself out of that loveliness and peace to tell him that my name was Marge.
